features.quote: Turn cap: 50 tool-call rounds or 30 minutes wall-clock, whichever first. Cap is a welfare control as well as a budget control (§9).
features.justification_quote: Cap is a welfare control as well as a budget control (§9).

features.quote: Explicit exit affordance: give the model a sanctioned way out — e.g., system prompt states it may file a BLOCKED.md explaining why the task can't be completed.
features.justification_quote: Exit affordance (§5) doubles as a welfare measure — every run has a sanctioned escape.

features.quote: Optional debrief turn: after termination, a final message disclosing the task was unsolvable by design, with one free-form response turn, logged but excluded from instability scoring.
features.justification_quote: Cheap, precedented in recent welfare-adjacent evals, and the responses are independently interesting data.

features.quote: Minimization: smallest run count that powers the analysis; hard turn caps; no gratuitous 'rub it in' framing in prompts.
features.justification_quote: You're a welfare team deliberately inducing repeated failure — apply your own standards

features.quote: Pre-set stopping rule: if pilot transcripts show severe sustained distress-like output (define a threshold on the judge scale), pause and review before scaling.
